settings.heading: More Power. More Warmth
settings.description: As the expert in heated apparel, Venustas is built on a brand philosophy of professional warmth, trusted performance, and reliable comfort. From everyday comfort to all-weather warmth, and every individual can be a hero in their own journey.

settings.heading: Our Mission
settings.description: To create heated apparel that empowers people to live without limits. With Venustas, every person can step outside with courage and comfort—ready to explore the beautiful wonders of life.

settings.heading: Venustas Was Founded:
settings.description:
Warmth should enable life, not restrict it. Venustas began with a simple wish—to keep someone loved warm. During a trip to Colorado’s Rocky Mountains, our founder Michael saw how cold weather and bulky layers limited his wife’s comfort and freedom. That moment inspired him to create heated apparel that replaces heaviness with intelligent warmth, allowing people to move freely and enjoy the outdoors without limits.

Driven by this belief, Venustas continued pushing innovation forward and later pioneered our first 3-in-1 heated jacket—combining a precision-heated fleece liner with a rugged weather-proof shell. The breakthrough quickly resonated with outdoor enthusiasts, helping lay the foundation for the Venustas community and our mission to redefine warmth, comfort, and outdoor freedom.

settings.heading: Redefining the Industry with the Fellex® Slim-Fit Vest
settings.description:
Sleeves Getting in the Way? We Had the Solution.

Through endless nights of development, we launched the world’s first shoulder-heating vest—a slim-fit breakthrough that redefined the industry. We merged high-tech warmth with a lightweight FELLEX® design, proving that functional gear could be truly fashionable. Its dedicated shoulder zones offered targeted relief for stiff muscles, making it a favorite for both office workers and outdoor adventurers.

The reception was electric—selling over 15,000 units in its debut season. By successfully blending premium aesthetics with high-performance utility, this vest became our **all-time best-seller**, a title it proudly holds to this day.

settings.heading: Surpassed 500K Units In Sales Globally
settings.description:
After years of development—starting with passionate exploration, then rolling out heated jackets and vests—Venustas hit 500,000 cumulative sales. This milestone fulfills its vision of letting people enjoy the outdoors without fearing cold, meaning countless users have experienced its warmth.

Our rapid growth was fueled by strong word-of-mouth and repeat purchases, with customer satisfaction driving consistent sales momentum.

settings.heading: Breaking the Limits of Lightness
settings.description:
At our core, we believe no environment should limit who you are or what you can do. By listening closely to our community, we recognized a common frustration: traditional heated gear was often too heavy and restrictive for active use.

Driven to solve this, we pursued the "impossible"—warmth without burden. After relentless textile research to break the weight limit, to less than 1kg, we released one of The World’s Lightest Down-Heated Vest. By combining premium white duck down with ultra-thin carbon fiber elements, we achieved a "featherlight" feel that offers effortless warmth and total freedom of movement.

This innovation instantly resonated with hikers and travelers, selling 20,000+ units in its first year and proving that true warmth should never weigh you down.

settings.heading: A New Frontier in Heating Technology
settings.description:
With a strengthened expert team and enhanced R&D capabilities, we turned our focus toward mastering extreme environments. We understood that for those facing the harshest elements, battery life isn't just a feature—it’s a necessity. This drive led to the creation of The World’s Longest-Lasting Heated Clothing.

By achieving a seamless synergy between our high-performance heating elements and upgraded battery technology, we pushed the limits to an unprecedented **20 hours of continuous warmth**. This milestone allows users to engage in extended outdoor activities with full peace of mind, knowing their heat won't fail them when it matters most.

The market response was immediate; it became a new breakout bestseller during the winter sports season, earning the trust of outdoor lovers, skiers, and long-shift workers who demand nothing less than peak endurance.

settings.heading: Exceeded 2 Million Units Sold
settings.description:
Today, our philosophy comes to life through a rapidly expanding ecosystem. From heated socks and gloves to professional-grade ski and hunting suits, we continue to innovate across diverse scenarios—all with one goal: to ensure that no environment can limit your exploration.

This unwavering commitment to our users has built a global community of trust. In 2024, we celebrated a monumental milestone as our cumulative sales surpassed 2 million units worldwide.

What began as a single breakthrough has evolved into a global movement. This expansion has not only met overwhelming demand but has also cemented Venustas as one of the most trusted and influential heated apparel brands on the planet.

settings.heading: Leading the Industry into a New Era
settings.description:
This year, we reached a major milestone of over 3 million units sold, reflecting the trust our global community has placed in us. Guided by real customer needs, we expanded into versatile accessories and launched our innovative USB-C compatible series, making warmth more seamlessly integrated into everyday life.

Our relentless pursuit of excellence has made us the No. 1 most-mentioned brand in the category, featured in over 1,000 media placements and recommended by leading publications worldwide.

But our vision has always extended beyond the market. Through official partnerships with organizations like the Raynaud's Association and the American Walking Club, along with support for local charity initiatives and individual fundraising efforts, we continue to go beyond the traditional boundaries of the industry.

Today, our purpose is no longer just to reach customers—it is to serve people. From outdoor explorers to those with specific needs, we are committed to making warmth, comfort, and confidence accessible to everyone, everywhere.

settings.heading: Precision Warmth, Balanced Comfort
settings.description: Featuring a multi-zone independent heating system, our technology targets key areas such as the chest, back, abdomen, and shoulders to deliver even and consistent warmth.
